room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken; excludes cumulative bonus in SI calculation

copayment.note: Voluntary co-pay of 10% or 20% available for premium discount; zone-based co-pay applies if Zone B/C insured treats in Zone A

sub_limits.display: Cataract 20% of SI/eye max ₹1L; Bariatric 25% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at 20% of SI per eye max ₹1,00,000; Bariatric surgery capped at 25% of SI after 36-month wait

deductible.note: Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹50,000/₹1,00,000/₹2,00,000/₹3,00,000 available for premium discount

specific_disease_waiting.note: 27 listed conditions including cataracts, hernia, fistula, mental illness, chronic kidney disease, Alzheimer's etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is excluded under Silver Plan (Excl18 applies)

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100% over 10 years; reduced by 10% after a claim year

restoration.note: Triggered only after full SI + cumulative bonus exhausted; once per policy year; for Cancer and Kidney Failure only once in lifetime

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary cover mentioned for Health Guard section

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to Sum Insured in government or accredited AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered subject to Transplantation Act compliance

ambulance.note: Road ambulance; covers transfer to nearest hospital and inter-hospital transfer

modern_treatments.note: Annexure III list including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy etc.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables listed in Annexure II are excluded; medical consumables within hospitalisation covered

notable_exclusions: No treatment outside India; no domiciliary; no maternity; 36-mo joint replacement/vertebral/bariatric wait; no IVF/infertility
optional_riders: Air ambulance (SI ≥5L), voluntary co-pay 10%/20%, voluntary aggregate deductible, room rent capping discount
